rubrics.justification: The response accurately describes the blastocyst as full-to-expanded with thinning zona, identifies a compact ICM region, and notes cohesive TE. Appropriately acknowledges image quality limitations. Correctly flags the Gardner staging discrepancy (3AA vs likely 4AA). Minor deduction for not more precisely characterizing the blastocoel cavity size or specific TE cell count/arrangement visible in the image.

Excellent integration of all major clinical factors: age 36 linked to aneuploidy risk, endometriosis connected to oocyte quality/receptivity/inflammatory environment, smoking tied to implantation and miscarriage risk, AMH/FSH/oocyte yield contextualized for prognosis, semen parameters assessed, endometrial thickness evaluated, BMI and lifestyle factors incorporated. The fresh transfer hormonal milieu concern with 22 COCs retrieved shows sophisticated integration.

The reasoning is highly coherent and internally consistent. The probability estimate of 35-50% logically follows from balancing favorable factors (Day 5, AA morphology, good lining, normal BMI) against negative factors (age 36 aneuploidy risk, endometriosis, smoking). The distinction between implantation probability and live birth rate is clearly maintained. The euploid vs untested embryo comparison is well-reasoned. No contradictions identified.

Strongly aligned with ESHRE/ASRM guidelines: recommends single embryo transfer for good-quality Day 5 blastocyst at 36, appropriately discusses PGT-A as optional rather than mandatory, correctly advises against routine ERA/immune testing/anticoagulation after single failure, addresses freeze-all considerations for high responders, recommends hysteroscopy only after repeated failure. Gardner grading critique is technically accurate per standard conventions.

Highly actionable with specific, prioritized recommendations: immediate smoking cessation as top priority, alcohol cessation from transfer onward, vitamin D optimization, single embryo transfer rationale, fresh vs frozen transfer considerations, and a structured future planning pathway including embryo cohort review, uterine assessment timing, endometriosis-specific GnRH agonist downregulation consideration, and PGT-A discussion criteria. Appropriately avoids recommending low-evidence interventions.
